evidenceActuallyInspected.note: 567 geometry samples report no mismatch/invalid. Comparison metadata reports 1956 frames at 30fps/65.2s. Full emotion reel reports 2655 frames at 30fps. These are not subjective continuous-motion or device tests.
Actually viewed in preceding round. The current character/paint is byte-identical; unchanged 32px night and contour limitations remain in this whole-foundation score, not falsely credited as fixed.

strengths: Grateful now places the paired mittens below the ruff rather than on its scalloped band. The 160/240px day/night comparisons show a useful separation in vertical hierarchy while retaining intentional clasped contact and the short arms.

Thinking lowers and turns the free mitten, keeping the chin contact purposeful. Focused gives both lower hands more surrounding torso. These improve silhouette/overlap without changing the chosen small body or hand shapes.

The offering mitten moves farther from the collar and rotates to a more open cup. The complete 1610–4100ms authored pose sheets show the hand progressing from thought to a distinct held offer in both themes. At 128–240px this reads more clearly as a hand on the body/wing boundary, with no new anatomy.

At 320/390px the current 790ms head/gaze is more upward than the before example and sits coherently under the question. The 1190ms phone still maintains that attention; 2350/2720ms frames return to the visitor and offering pose. Desktop 1440px keeps the useful side-by-side relation.

The whole emotion sheet preserves the same innocent huge head, compact torso, four layered wings, paddle asymmetry and stub feet. The night theme retains the same shapes and pose staging; all12 frozen-source hashes match and character/paint is byte-identical.
